messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: boost ode solver
parts:
Boost has added ODE solvers. They now have
a symplectic integrator concept!

http://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_53_0/libs/numeric/odeint/doc/html/boost_numeric_odeint/concepts/symplectic_system.html

- Bob

messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] boost ode solver
parts:

"leapfrog" integrator is conspicuously absent, presumably it'd be easy
to get them to add it.

Matt
